data_protocol.split: Per-student chronological 60/20/20 with occurred_at ascending and source-order tie-breaker.
data_protocol.future_leakage: Only warm train labels can fit rate baselines, NCDM, ORCDF, response graphs, and mastery vectors. Validation selects once; test is evaluated only after selection.

baselines.majority: Always predicts the observed warm-train majority class.
baselines.global: Predicts the warm-train global correct rate.
baselines.exercise: Predicts Exercise historical correct rate from warm-train rows; unseen Exercises fall back to global rate.
baselines.topic: Predicts Topic historical correct rate from warm-train rows; unseen Topics fall back to global rate.

ncdm.reference_component: InsCD NCDM / Default extractor / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.

orcdf.reference_component: InsCD ORCDF response graph / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.

doa.definition: Exercise-conditioned pairwise agreement: later correct versus later incorrect students on the same Exercise are ordered by the Q-topic mastery fitted from warm-train history; ties score one half.
